description: What are the symbol, name, decimals, contract address and issuer of this stablecoin on this chain? Paid ($0.001 USDC): Cited stablecoin token facts from a prepared dataset (USDC, EURC, USDT, PYUSD, DAI on the chains /v1/chain covers, where a permissively licensed source lists them): symbol, name, decimals, contract address, chain, issuer, each with a source citation and license. Fields not established from a source are the string "unknown". Malformed input and tokens not in the dataset return 400/404 and are never charged. This server holds no wallet and never pays: it returns the HTTP 402 payment requirements (x402 on Base, MPP on Tempo) and the URL https://payments-intel-production.up.railway.app/v1/token. Pay with your own x402/MPP client and retry that URL. Paid: $0.001 per call (x402/MPP).

address.description: Token contract / mint address (give address or symbol)

chain.description: Chain slug, name or CAIP-2 id, e.g. base, solana, eip155:8453

symbol.description: Stablecoin ticker, e.g. USDC (give symbol or address)
